definitions.explanation: Having many different forms, types, or elements. Used to describe variety in people, opinions, cultures, methods, and more.

examples.japanese: {多様|たよう}な{意見|いけん}がある。
{多様|たよう}な{働|はたら}き{方|かた}が{求|もと}められている。
examples.english: Diverse ways of working are being sought.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}には{多様|たよう}な{文化|ぶんか}を{持|も}つ{人々|ひとびと}が{暮|く}らしている。
examples.english: People with diverse cultures live in this area.

notes:
A な-adjective formed from {多様|たよう}, a compound of {多|た} (many) and {様|よう} (manner, form). Very common in formal writing, news, and discussions about society, education, and business.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多様|たよう}な{価値観|かちかん} — diverse values
- {多様|たよう}なニーズ — diverse needs
- {多様|たよう}な{人材|じんざい} — diverse talent/personnel
- {多様|たよう}な{選択肢|せんたくし} — various options
- {多様性|たようせい} — diversity (noun form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {様々|さまざま}な — various (slightly more casual, very common)
- {色々|いろいろ}な — various (more casual, everyday use)
- {多彩|たさい}な — colorful, varied (emphasizes richness)
